controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T18:35:55.500Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T19:35:55.500Z"
| WHERE falco.rule IS NOT NULL
| STATS events = COUNT(*)
        BY host.name, data_stream.dataset
| SORT events DESC
